qualifier: excitatory pre- and postsynaptic membrane assembly
name: Trans-synaptic adhesion driving excitatory pre- and postsynaptic assembly
rationale: All members concern synaptic adhesion organizers (neurexin-neuroligin, SALMs, LAR-RPTPs) building pre- and postsynaptic membranes with PSD-95/NMDA receptor clustering, unlike confusables centred on EPSP regulation, synapse-assembly regulation or inhibitory GABA/gephyrin synapses.

name: Glycinergic inhibitory neurotransmission in sensory and respiratory control
rationale: Members share inhibitory (glycinergic, MECP2-regulated GABA) dampening of nerve impulse transmission affecting touch and breathing, whereas confusables cover GABA synthesis/reuptake or locomotor behaviour.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
qualifier: zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium rather than iron
name: Zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium transport and homeostasis
rationale: All members concern transport, homeostasis or detoxification of zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium or cobalt (SLC30/SLC39, metallothioneins), distinguishing it from iron/heme handling and MTF1-driven metal-response confusables.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and membrane organization
qualifier: protein processing, cristae and contact sites
name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and membrane organization
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial protein/RNA import, processing and degradation, cristae and outer-membrane organization and calcium uptake, without the mitophagy/fission regulation or respiratory-complex assembly of the confusables.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosyl glycosylation and skeletal muscle development
rationale: Members are DAG1 core M1-M3 and matriglycan glycosylation, their dystroglycanopathy defects and muscle/diaphragm development, distinct from keratan/GAG glycosylation and dystrophin-complex/basement-membrane confusables.

name: Corticotropin-stimulated glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: All three members concern ACTH-driven cortisol/glucocorticoid secretion, whereas confusables cover CRH responses, stress behaviour or glucocorticoid responses rather than secretion.

name: TRAIL death receptor caspase-8 activation and c-FLIP inhibition
rationale: Members concern TRAIL-induced procaspase-8 dimerization and its inhibition by c-FLIP, distinct from Fas/BID-centred extrinsic apoptosis and necroptosis confusables.

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly and E-cadherin turnover
rationale: Members share calcium-dependent cadherin cell-cell adhesion at adherens junctions, with CDH1 processing, trafficking, degradation and apoptotic cleavage that the EMT- and adhesion-regulation confusables lack.

qualifier: phase I and II enzymatic oxidation and conjugation
name: Phase I and II enzymatic xenobiotic and toxin biotransformation
rationale: Members cover CYP/FMO oxidation, methylation, acetylation and sulfonation of drugs, toxins, ethanol and plant compounds plus AhR induction, unlike confusables centred on transporter-mediated drug ADME or aldehyde detoxification.

qualifier: de novo synthesis plus intermembrane lipid transfer
name: De novo glycerophospholipid synthesis and intermembrane lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover de novo synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PI, PG, cardiolipin and plasmalogens plus lipid transfer between membranes, distinguishing it from acyl-chain remodelling and sphingolipid confusables.

Members mix choline/acetylcholine transport (SLC5A7), creatine-phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange, lysophospholipid hydrolysis, pyrophosphate hydrolysis and bile acid transport, with no single biological process common to all.

name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation and mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are lysosomal catabolism of heparan, chondroitin/dermatan, keratan sulfate and hyaluronan and the MPS diseases caused by its defects, unlike GAG-biosynthesis and glycosphingolipid-catabolism confusables.

name: SLC26-mediated sulfate and oxalate anion exchange
rationale: All members concern SLC26 anion exchangers moving sulfate and oxalate, distinct from sodium-coupled carboxylate and bicarbonate-transporter confusables.

name: Desmosomal cell adhesion linking intermediate filaments in cardiomyocytes
rationale: Members share desmosome assembly, intermediate filament bundling and cardiomyocyte adhesion affecting ventricular action potentials, unlike epithelial adherens-junction and hemidesmosome confusables.

name: Bicarbonate transport with enamel mineralization and tooth eruption
rationale: Members concern SLC4 bicarbonate transport and SLC24A4-dependent enamel mineralization/tooth eruption, which the SLC26 and carbonic-anhydrase confusables lack.

name: PALB2-BRCA1-BRCA2 homologous recombination via synthesis-dependent strand annealing
rationale: Members concern PALB2 bridging BRCA1 and BRCA2 in HRR and D-loop resolution by SDSA, distinct from single-strand annealing, end resection and BRCA1/BARD1 damage-response confusables.

name: Cystine-glutamate exchange and glutathione turnover suppressing ferroptosis
rationale: Members cover cystine import, glutamate homeostasis, glutathione transport and catabolism and negative regulation of ferroptosis, unlike glutathione-synthesis defect and ROS/NADPH confusables.

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion driving mesenchymal fibroblast migration and spreading
rationale: Members share integrin/syndecan-fibronectin adhesion, focal adhesion and stress fibre formation and fibroblast/EMT migration programmes, distinct from MET-PTK2 and bare ECM-module confusables.

qualifier: follicle growth, ovulation and luteal phase
name: Ovarian follicle growth, ovulation and corpus luteum cycle
rationale: Members cover antral follicle growth, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and estrous cycle, unlike oocyte-maturation, testicular and gonadotropin-response confusables.

qualifier: Th2 cytokines, mast cells and eosinophils
name: Th2, mast cell and eosinophil type 2 allergic immunity
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13/33 signaling, FcεRI mast cell activation, eosinophils and IgE switching, unlike IL-2/STAT5, IL-17/IL-23 and Fc-gamma/BCR confusables.

name: Vascular smooth muscle tone in arterial blood pressure regulation
rationale: Members cover arterial vasoconstriction and relaxation (endothelin, catecholamine, cGMP) setting systemic and pulmonary pressure, unlike general smooth muscle, NO-synthase and renin-angiotensin confusables.

qualifier: blood vessel remodeling and endothelial apoptosis
name: Vascular injury repair and blood vessel remodeling
rationale: Members concern vascular wound healing, endothelial apoptosis, vessel remodeling and smooth muscle adaptation, unlike angiogenic sprouting and smooth muscle phenotypic-switching confusables.

qualifier: nucleotide sugars, dolichol and GPI anchors
name: Nucleotide-sugar, dolichol and GPI precursor synthesis for glycosylation
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar synthesis/transport, dolichol-linked oligosaccharide and GPI anchor assembly and their congenital glycosylation disorders, unlike glycan-catabolism and N/O-glycan elongation confusables.

core: Rho and integrin signaling to actin
name: Rho-ROCK/PAK and ILK signaling to SRF-driven actin cytoskeleton
rationale: Members share Rho-ROCK/PAK and ILK-PINCH-parvin focal adhesion signaling and SRF actin/contractile target genes, which the integrin-matrix and fibronectin confusables lack.

name: Endocytic receptor recycling and endosome organization
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane-endosome traffic and recycling of receptors back to the surface, unlike synaptic receptor trafficking, Golgi-endosome and internalization confusables.
